Review.ItemLabel: UAT-1: SystemAdmin signs in via magic link, navigates to Manage Organization Admins, and sees the renamed page heading plus the dashboard cross-link banner

Steps.Action: CLICK INPUT with label "Email address" and enter "admin@acmecoffee.com"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Send sign-in link"
VERIFY TEXT contains "We sent a sign-in code to"

Verifications.Text: Page heading reads 'Manage Organization Admins' (not the old 'User Administration')

Steps.Action: VERIFY TEXT contains "Open the Security Dashboard"

Verifications.Text: A blue info banner is visible offering to open the Security Dashboard's Users and Role Assignment tab

Review.ItemLabel: UAT-2: After signing in, SystemAdmin clicks the dashboard banner link on Manage Organization Admins and lands on the Security Dashboard's Users and Role Assignment tab

Steps.Action: CLICK INPUT with label "Email address" and enter "admin@acmecoffee.com"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Send sign-in link"
CLICK LINK with text "Open the Security Dashboard → Users and Role Assignment tab"
CLICK TAB with name "USERS AND ROLE ASSIGNMENT"
VERIFY TEXT contains "Search users by name, email, role, or organization"

Verifications.Text: The Users and Role Assignment tab is active and the user search grid is visible

Review.Subarea: Dashboard Tab Excludes UserAdmin; Cross-Link Back To /admin/users
Review.ItemLabel: UAT-3: SystemAdmin signs in, opens the dashboard Users tab, selects a user, confirms UserAdmin is excluded from the role dropdown, and uses the cross-link to navigate back to Manage Organization Admins for the correct org
Review.Feedback: The Role dropdown has no values in it

Steps.Action: CLICK INPUT with label "Email address" and enter "admin@acmecoffee.com"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Send sign-in link"
CLICK TAB with name "USERS AND ROLE ASSIGNMENT"
VERIFY TEXT contains "Search users by name, email, role, or organization"

Verifications.Text: Click any user row in the grid to open the detail panel below
In the 'Assign role' dropdown, confirm UserAdmin / 'User Administrator (UserAdmin)' is NOT in the options
Confirm an info banner reads 'To grant or revoke UserAdmin access for this user, use Manage Organization Admins:' followed by at least one 'Manage org admins for <OrgName>' link
Click one of the 'Manage org admins for <OrgName>' links and confirm you land on /admin/users after the org-switch redirect

Review.Subarea: Dashboard Tab Excludes UserAdmin; Cross-Link Back To /admin/users
